title: Enterprise request cataloging, prioritization, and initial cost estimator
creator: Marina Alvarez
description: Goal: Create a lightweight, repeatable catalogue and prioritization surface for Sales/CS to submit enterprise (non-bug) feature requests that produces: 1) a canonical request record, 2) a priority score and rationale, and 3) a first-pass engineering cost estimator (T-shirt + rough $k) to speed PM/ENG intake and discovery decisions. This ticket scopes the template, scoring formula, integration points (CRM -> Linear), and a short pilot run with three accounts. Outcome should reduce back-and-forth clarification and cut initial scoping lead time from ~7 business days to <=48 hours for triaged asks.
acceptance_criteria: A template with required fields (use-case, MVE, data residency, latency SLOs, key success metrics) is finalized and published to Confluence
A prioritization rubric (scorecard) is documented and maps to three priority buckets (QuickWin / Needs-Design / Dedicated-Eng effort)
A deterministic T-shirt sizing -> engineering points -> rough $k mapping exists and is validated by 2 eng leads
Sales/CS intake form prototype is tested in pilot with 3 accounts and feedback incorporated
Training notes and a short playbook (1 page) are delivered for Sales/CS and Solutions Engineers
implementation_steps: Draft intake schema: required/optional fields, example content, and clarifying prompts
Define scoring dimensions and weights (impact, technical risk, data sensitivity, revenue/ARR opportunity, alignment to roadmap)
Create T-shirt sizing guidelines and a lookup table to convert to story points and rough cost ranges
Wireframe a lightweight Google/Form + Zapier flow to create canonical ticket in Linear and populate key metadata
Run a 2-week pilot with 3 enterprise accounts and collect structured feedback
Iterate template and scoring, then build a small integration (Salesforce -> Confluence link + Linear ticket) in next sprint
scoping_example: Example ask: 'VPC private endpoint + audit log export for Customer X'
Filled fields: Use-case=regulated financial customer; Benefit=onboarding Customer X (>$250k ARR); Data residency=EU-only; Latency SLO=100ms for auth calls
Score: impact=8, risk=6, revenue=9, roadmap-fit=4 => normalized priority bucket=Needs-Design
Size: T-shirt=M -> 8-13 story points -> estimated eng effort 2-4 dev-weeks -> rough cost=$35k-$70k (infra + eng)
Recommended next step: Schedule 60m scoping session with Solutions Eng + Infra Eng and capture a discovery PRD
comments: 2026-03-02 Marina Alvarez: Drafted initial scoring rubric and T-shirt mapping. Shared with Solutions Eng for feedback.

2026-03-03 Rahul Patel (Solutions Eng): Questioned weight on 'roadmap-fit' — suggested reducing from 25% to 15% to avoid biasing against high-revenue demos. Noted we must include a field for regulatory/contractual blockers.
2026-03-04 Liam Chen: Validated M/L engineering ranges for M and L sizes; recommended adding a 'dependencies' checkbox to surface infra work (networking, KMS, on-prem packaging).

2026-03-05 Product Review: Approved pilot plan (3 accounts: FinCo EU, HealthAI US, RetailChain APAC). Action: run pilot for 10 business days and report metrics (time-to-first-scope, #clarification cycles).
